systemic_problems: S1 v2 has no working quality scale. The judge is report-only, validate sits at 10, and the retry loop cannot fire. So S1 quality rests on code gates plus Jev, with no end-to-end score or human sample. This is why problems come back as one-off fixes found in audits or by reviewers instead of being caught by a gate.

Gates sit on some exits but not on all of them. The hitl exit skips grounding and the day guard, an unedited Approve skips every server gate, and T3 skips the meal check. A page can reach Master or a tenant through a door its own gates never checked.
Policy rules are encoded as narrow regexes on one field (elephant riding on highlights only, missing 'elephant riding') with no test corpus taken from the policy text.

Model choice and effort can change outside the eval gate. Judge chains fall through to uncalibrated models without a hold. Writer effort and stage_model_params are not covered by the writer eval gate (migration 381 notes). Fallback writes publish by default.
The T2 cost and latency envelope is unbounded in practice: nested loops (3 graphs x 3 drafts x 3 judges, plus job retry) at high effort on an 8192 ceiling that is already 90% used.
No threshold is calibrated (all calibrated:false), so every pass/retry/hold decision is set by hand.

Data not available for this lens (needs a pull): review_queue pending counts and reasons, T2 tenant_tour_versions status/qa_status/judge_breakdown distribution, and Writing Lab shared.eval_item_result for writers a1 and t2.
proposals: Give S1 v2 one calibrated, gating quality signal. Either flip A1_V2_BRAND_FIT_GATE=enforce after the planned 125-page re-measure, or replace it with a code-check gate score (s1_checks.run_checks serious-error proxy) that feeds should_retry and the published score. Pin it with a golden-set regression in CI.

Make every exit pass the same final gate. Route the A1 hitl exit through grounding, final_day_guard and the degraded hold before END. Make the review approve endpoint refuse an unedited version that has hard codes, ungrounded sentences or a held degraded detector, unless an explicit override reason is given.

Rewrite the elephant-riding detector from the policy wording ('elephant riding', 'ride/riding an elephant', 'elephant trek/back/ride') over every generated field and the source. Add a test corpus to tests/unit, and mark source tours at A0 so any rewrite goes to human review.

Before the next S1 wave on the Anthropic API, run a paid trial of about 3 tours to measure s1_generate tokens and cost at high vs medium effort. Bring t2_generate under token_budget.py (or raise its ceiling) and decide its effort with the planned quality read.

Add the brand audit's uncalibrated-connection hold to s1_judge and t2_judge verdicts: a judge answered on acc2/nova-lite can lower a score but never pass a draft. Put stage_model_params changes under the writer eval gate.
Cap T2 total writes per tour (for example 4 Sonnet writes across graph plus T3) and make T3 rounds revise only, not rerun the full 3-draft graph.
Pull the missing aggregates (review_queue reasons, T2 version status/qa distribution, Writing Lab a1/t2 results) before the quality decision.

systemic_problems: Fixes target symptoms, so families come back with new causes. Meal-time took 4 fixes, all regex/prompt, with 3 recurrences. Day loss took 7 fixes, and 3 published losses still happened afterwards (Rajasthan, Japan quoted headings, 3/745 scan). Pakistan/Philippines was fixed in one country list (10-01) and missed in another (10-27). flag_fix brought back forbidden words and later dropped days. Each fix targeted the cause at hand rather than the family invariant (fact sheet vs page, days kept, one country source).

The success metric is saturated. Since writer v2, quality_score is about 10 (avg 9.99, p10 10.00) because brand fit and two length/DFS codes are report-only on v2 drafts, and the brand dimension is 10.00 in every week. No weekly per-code series exists, so 'did it come back' cannot be answered from the pipeline's own numbers.

Detectors stay in shadow and judges stay report-only for a long time. All 9 day-oracle codes, NUMBER_NOT_IN_SOURCE, NAME_NOT_IN_SOURCE, META_CUT/META_CUT_SIGNATURE, INCLUSION_CONTRADICTED and repair_contract are shadow, and the only source-reading A1 judge (brand-fit v2) is report-only, during a gate freeze that ends around 19/11. The page can therefore carry a known defect while every enforced gate passes, as the Japan page did at score 10.

The judges are uncalibrated and their model changes with routing. Agreement was κ 0.03 for s1_judge, 0.137 for the R2 eval and 0.40 for the AA-790 voice rubric. 30-day s1_judge verdicts are split between 2 models, and t2_judge answers came from 4 model/connection pairs, one of them nova-lite with a 2-token median output. Only writer fallbacks are marked (route_guard) and only brand_audit@acc2 passes are held, so judge drift is invisible.

T2 relies on the Master text and has almost no fidelity detectors. The registry lists no T2 detector for inclusion, misbinding, names, direction, embellishment, day structure or persona promises. Its judge is brand-fit v1, which does not reward fidelity, so T2 quality is judged by brand voice alone.

The review queue has no owner. About 50 tours have waited since S218 (51 then, 50 now). Five fixes were to UI and states, and none drains the queue or sets an SLA; review_status is stale on 891 published tours.

Truncation was under-counted before the ledger v2 'cut' class existed (cut=0 in every earlier week despite rows with stop=max_tokens). T2 generate still sits at 91% of its 8192 ceiling at effort high, outside the token_budget module that #1330 created for T8/T9.
proposals: Build one weekly recurrence report per taxonomy class, split by writer, writer_version and judge model. It should read quality_scores.failure_codes, brand-audit codes and quality_shadow, including shadow and report-only codes. Use it as the regression signal instead of average quality_score. The pull is free: one aggregate query added to the orchestrator script.

Turn every past incident into a parameterised fixture in the Q0 quality corpus (#891 red-on-base CI): Rajasthan 15→10, Japan quoted 'Day 5', the v2 'Meals: dinner.' line, a flag_fix whole-field rewrite, the Pakistan/Philippines lists and the S218 India elephant-riding tours. That way a family cannot come back unnoticed. Extend the same corpus to T2 using the Master text as input (lesson AA-800).

Retire the meal/time regex in favour of the code-built fact sheet (s1_facts included/excluded/schedule lines). After reading its precision on the 810 v2 pages for $0, promote INCLUSION_CONTRADICTED. This closes the family at its invariant: the page may state a meal or time only when the fact sheet has it.

When the gate freeze ends (~19/11), read precision on stored v2 pages and promote at least DAY_COUNT_VS_DURATION, DAY_OUTPUT_GAP and META_CUT_SIGNATURE to enforce on A1, as the AA-645 memo proposed. Keep repair_contract days_kept as an enforced invariant rather than shadow.

Pin the judge per verdict. Store judge model and connection on quality_scores and tenant_tour_versions, extend route_guard (or the uncalibrated hold) to the judge role so a verdict from a fallback or uncalibrated judge is marked or held, and require a calibration read (κ against the S248/S250 panel labels) before a new judge model gates a wave.

Give T2 a free source-fidelity layer. Run the A1 code checks (s1_checks / fact sheet: numbers, names, inclusions, days) on the T2 draft against the Master text and source, and register them as T2 detectors in taxonomy.yaml. Then score T2 with a brand-fit v2-style rubric that rewards staying within the source, report-only until κ ≥ 0.6.

Give the review queue an owner and an exit. Drain or label the ~50 stuck tours (elephant-riding ones stay as they are under the policy), add a reason taxonomy and an age alert, and set review_status on published tours so the column means something.

Move t2_generate onto services/acp_shared/token_budget.py with a ceiling of about 16000, matching the S1 v2 writer, or test effort 'medium' in a small paid trial (~3 tours) before phase 2 of AA-741. Backfill a 'cut' flag for historical rows with stop=max_tokens so truncation trends are readable.

systemic_problems: Each topic's rule exists as hand-written prose in 8 to 11 places: W prompt, v1 _RULES_3_TO_6, T2 prompt, flag_fix, _rerepair_meta, AA_BRAND_IDENTITY_PROMPT, the brand-audit user prompt, brand_fit v1 and v2, the eval judge rubric and the house-style doc. Each copy carries its own numbers: meta 130-148 / 140-155 / 145-152 / 140-160, highlights 3 / 4 / 6 / no max. thresholds.yaml and taxonomy.yaml hold thresholds and classes, but not the rule text or bands that writers are given, so every fix lands in one copy and the others drift.

Repairs cannot see the source while checks can. flag_fix and _rerepair_meta see no source, while grounding, the meal check and the v2 judge do. Each check therefore triggers a source-free rewrite that can drop real facts (meals, days) or invent new ones (the 'practical reassurance' in a meta). Nothing checks seo_meta claims after a repair, so the cycle of repeated fixes is built into the graph.

The rules split by writer version and path instead of being one policy. v2 fixes sit behind is_v2() branches in validate, judge, brand audit and the meal exemption. The v1 prompt, still used for the batch seed, A+, the flag-off fallback and all of T2, keeps the old invitations (transfers, guides, 'audience', meal stripping), and T2 inherits none of the A1 fixes: no source-backed meal exemption, judge still on rubric v1.

Writers and checkers read different sources. A1 agency fields reach only the writer and the v2 judge. The T2 FACTS block and brand pack reach the writer but not the Writing Lab judge, and the T2 judge never sees the source. False flags follow, and so do judges that reward invention.

Judge goals pull against the writer's goal. The T2 brand-fit anchors reward per-day brand framing and 'different details' with no source check, and that feedback is merged into the same revision as the fact-fix feedback.
Policy holds are recorded as defects. Elephant riding is classed fact.inclusion, the detector reads highlights only, and no writer prompt mentions the policy.

Some deterministic checks are dead or mis-scoped (generic day-title regex, STOCK_SUPERLATIVE labelled A1), and 'block' taxonomy classes have no enforcing A1/T2 detector. The registry overstates what is guarded.
The stored score saturates: average 9.99 on v2. Report-only gates are not part of the number people read, so the score cannot show whether quality improved.

Judge identity is not pinned: the T2 judge fell through to nova-lite or refusals in week 11-02, and the Writing Lab judge changes model with routing. A change in score may reflect a different judge, not a change in quality.
proposals: Write one policy registry, for example services/quality/writing_policy.yaml, with one entry per topic: id, rule text, numeric band, allowed exceptions, the writers it binds and its checkers. Render the W, v1, T2, flag_fix and meta-repair prompts, the brand-audit user prompt, brand_fit_v2 _HOUSE_STYLE and the eval LABEL_RUBRIC from it. Add a contract test that fails when a prompt states a band or word list not taken from the registry, in the style of test_s218_hard_code_repair. Highlights then become one band (3-6) and the meta one band (writer aim 142-150, gate 140-155).

Meals: pick one rule for every writer: 'copy the source day's meal list or code; never infer from prose'. Retire strip_itinerary_meal_metadata (prompts.py:333). Extend source_backed_meal_line to T2, whose source is the master page, and to tour-level INCLUDED meal lines. Measure ITINERARY_MEAL_TIME_INVENTED per writer_version on a 50-tour subset before and after.

Give every repair the same source the checker used. flag_fix and _rerepair_meta should receive the code-built fact sheet (render_fact_sheet), and the meta repair should take only relevant_keywords(), not the raw PAA[0]. Remove 'one practical reassurance' and 'add one concrete detail'. After any meta repair, run meta_problems (check_numbers plus the do-not-use list), or add seo_meta and seo_title to the grounded fields. For flagged itineraries, repair only the flagged sentences with the grounding sentence-repair contract instead of rewriting the whole itinerary.
Put the agency fields into the checkers' source. Merge with_agency_fields into the tour dict that grounding, the meal check and the Writing Lab a1 judge read, so writer and checker share one source.

Decide the background-number rule once. Either allow years, centuries and elevations in a background clause everywhere (reuse t3_background.is_background_number in the A1 numeric check, turn T3_BACKGROUND_FACTS on after a 3-then-50 tour trial, and add 'except a year in a background clause' to W rule 2), or remove 'era' from every writer prompt. Today the writers are told one thing and the checkers enforce the other.

Move the T2 judge to a source-aware rubric modelled on brand_fit_v2: the judge reads the master text, and source specificity replaces cross_brand_distinct. A faithful page on a thin source scores at least 7. Brand angle is scored on voice and framing, never on new details. Stop merging BRAND VOICE FEEDBACK into the fact-fix revision, or label it 'voice only, no new facts'. Calibrate it on the Writing Lab t2 golden items before it gates.

Elephant riding: one deterministic detector over every field, with gerund and verb forms and a test set. Add a line to every writer prompt: 'keep it as the source states it, no judgement words'. Keep held tours out of flag_fix even when they carry other codes. Map the code to a policy-hold class, not fact.inclusion.

Optional items: either W keeps optional items out of highlights and leaves them in the itinerary marked as optional, or HIGHLIGHTS_OPTIONAL_LANGUAGE accepts a highlight that starts with 'Optional:'. Never let flag_fix drop the qualifier: the repair contract should check that optional markers are kept.

Remove AA_BRAND_IDENTITY_PROMPT from the A1 brand audit and the contract smoke test; use the house-style text from the registry instead. Drop or rewrite the SEO_META_FORBIDDEN positioning words for the neutral master and keep them as a tenant-layer option. Fix the generic day-title regex to the em-dash format, or delete it.

Make the measured quality visible. Store the v2 report-only signals (unsupported specifics count, meal code, brand-audit codes) next to the score, or as a second score, so a 9.99 can no longer hide pages a later layer still changed.

Pin judges per run. Include the judge model key in judge_version and in the Writing Lab result row. Hold T2 judge scores from uncalibrated acc2 models (nova-lite) the same way the brand-audit pass is held. Treat a change of judge model as a new judge in any comparison.

Coverage gap: run F18_rarity and the stock-superlative rule in shadow on A1 and T2 (they are T9-only today), then enforce once precision is read on the golden set. Make taxonomy 'block' severity require at least one enforcing detector per listed writer (lint in registry.py).

systemic_problems: The score that should tell the tech lead whether tour writing is good is saturated. On v2 drafts, score_overall is the validate score alone (judge_node.py:369), and the codes that used to move it were made report-only and sent to quality_shadow, which the quality_scores table and dashboards do not aggregate. Week 10-19 shows avg 9.99 and p10 10.00, so a regression in writing quality would not show up in the score. The only discriminating evidence is a one-off blind panel (S250) and the shadow codes nobody counts.

Code detects most failure classes deterministically, but an LLM rewrites a whole field to repair them: meal/clock-time claims, 'Optional' highlights, meta length via meta_retry and flag_fix seo_meta. Each LLM repair is a fresh chance to introduce a new defect (S249 Rajasthan lost 5 days during a meal-line fix), and that leads to the next guard. This is the repeated-fix cycle: detector, LLM repair, new defect, new contract.

The writer itself produces the claim class it is then punished for. Prompt rule 7 asks the LLM to write meal and overnight fact lines (s1_writer_v2.py:258), while source_fact_lines() can copy them verbatim but only runs in the unused Arm E (s1_writer_v2.py:509).

T2 is one writer generation behind A1. It uses the v1 prompt, v1 gates (nudge, ITINERARY_STILL_COMPRESSED scored, judge min()'d) and the 8192 ceiling, now on Sonnet 5.5 at high effort with p95 output at 90% of the ceiling. Tenants get content from the path with weaker fidelity controls, even though T2 reads the v2 master text.

Fallback routing changes the judge silently (4 models on t2_judge, 2 on s1_judge in 30 d), and quality_scores does not store the judge model. Score trends and brand-fit before/after figures mix judges and cannot be compared over time.

The measurement queries mix superseded versions with live ones: about 2.6 score rows per tour, no join to published_tours.quality_score_id. Code-frequency tables mostly describe deleted v1 history, which can send fix effort to classes that are already solved, such as FORBIDDEN_WORD.

Missing outcome data for this question: review_queue causes, tenant_tour_versions status and qa_status, the quality_shadow code counts of v2 drafts, the F9 sub-codes after ':', and the identity of the 51 ingested tours. The err=0 result across all stages may come from NULL being coalesced to 'ok' on pre-v2 ledger rows rather than from real health.
proposals: Re-pull the stats against the live versions only, all aggregates and read-only. (a) Failure and brand codes for published_tours.quality_score_id, plus the v2 quality_shadow codes from generated_content.metadata, per code. (b) review_queue open rows by failure_summary class. (c) tenant_tour_versions by status x qa_status x qa_repair_count, with the judge_breakdown axis that set each score. (d) content_piece held_reason sub-code after ':' for F9. (e) The 51 ingested tour_ids against S218's review list and the elephant flag.

Make the meal/overnight fact line deterministic in writer v2 arm 'w'. Append source_fact_lines(day.source), the code Arm E already uses, and change rule 7 so the model never writes meal, time or overnight lines. Gate it on the golden set and a ≤50 shadow, measuring the ITINERARY_MEAL_TIME_INVENTED rate (now 25.6% of rows) and the flag_fix call rate (about 0.54 per tour). This removes the main trigger of the whole-itinerary LLM rewrite.

Replace the remaining LLM repairs of code-detected classes with code edits that keep the pages auditable. HIGHLIGHTS_OPTIONAL_LANGUAGE: drop the line or move it to an 'Optional extras' list. An unsupported clock time or meal sentence: delete the sentence, the same class of edit as the grounding fact editor. Seo_meta and title: ask the model for 2–3 candidates in one call and let code pick one that fits the band, instead of a char-count meta_retry on about 45% of tours. Each change goes into HARD_CODE_REPAIR as 'deterministic:'.

Make the score discriminate again without inventing a new gate. Publish a v2 quality index computed from the codes already recorded (quality_shadow codes per tour, brand-fit v2 caps, figure coverage, UNSUPPORTED_NUMBER), trended per week on live versions, with a regression alarm against the S250 blind-panel baseline (0.0015 serious errors per claim). Run the existing golden-set and blind-panel replay on every writer or prompt version change, which the AA-900 eval gate already provides.

Stop paying for a tripled report-only judge. When the A1 gate is brand_fit_report_only, skip the AA-714 near-band median of 3 (brand_fit.py:48-49) so the judge makes 1 call per tour: about 2.7 calls go to about 1, saving roughly $0.003 per tour and $2.8 per 810-tour catalogue pass. Store judge_model on quality_scores or in metadata so trends can be split by judge, and pin the judge model during a wave (refuse to fall back mid-wave) so wave before/after numbers stay comparable.

Bring T2 to writer v2 parity as a planned, gated step. Run the v2 fact-sheet writer with the tenant voice layer (or the v2 rules plus brand pack) behind a flag, raise the T2 ceiling to 16000 like WRITER_MAX_TOKENS, and run the effort A/B (high vs medium) that is still pending, on Writing Lab items: a trial of about 3, then 50 at most, before changing the default. Today's p95 of 7414 against 8192 makes truncation likely on long tours.

T9 F9_cta_fact, 74% of holds: insert the tenant CTA verbatim in code, or check it as a literal substring as the old F6 did, so CTA_NOT_REFLECTED never reaches the LLM judge. Keep FACT_CHECK and TEXT_INTEGRITY on the existing sentence-repair path, then measure first-attempt approval (now 22.6%) and the held rate (19.3%).

A3 cost: review a3_place_card_check. At $9.04 it costs about twice the card writer it checks. Either cut its input context or run it only on cards that a deterministic pre-check marks risky. Worth a ≤50 trial before the next places backfill.

systemic_problems: Token ceilings have been fixed per call site after each cut (17 commits since 01/09 that mention max_tokens, cuts or truncation: AA-639 8192, #1330, #1344, migrations 381 and 382). The gateway floor now exists, but exemptions (NO_RETRY_STAGES), the 4096 protocol default and call sites tuned in the 4.x era (graph.py:43-47) still decide budgets. Each new serving model shows the next cut only after it happens.

Quality evidence and gates are keyed on route configuration, not on the model and provider that actually served the call. acc3 denials, route v6 provider order, connection budget caps, cooldowns and runtime fallbacks all change the served model with no config change. So no eval, reverify or release flag fires, and the wave baselines (S249 on acc3 Converse) no longer describe what runs.

Judges are invisible in the degraded and fallback mechanism: only writer fallbacks are marked. Yet the T2 judge is the gate on tenant content, its route ends on an uncalibrated nova-lite, and at run time it can be the same model as the writer's last-resort fallback.

Thinking behaviour depends on the provider path: Converse sends no effort, the Messages API sends the family default, and OpenAI bills reasoning inside max_tokens. A provider move is treated as 'not a fallback', so it is never re-evaluated. Anthropic rows also report no reasoning tokens, so effort cannot be sized from the ledger.
